prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production sprite sheet of SIX EMPTY square action-button slots for RainShadow's parchment combat bar.
Reference image: the supplied game action bar is style reference only. Produce only the six empty slots, not a whole bar or icons.
Layout: exact regular 3 columns by 2 rows grid on a 3:2 canvas, six equally sized square cells, no gutters between cells. Each slot is centered inside its cell with a narrow transparent outer margin of 4% of cell width. All slots have identical geometry and border thickness. Front-on flat UI, no perspective.
Slot design: aged ivory parchment center, a narrow hand-inked inset frame with fine antique brass corner details and a softly feathered coloured ink wash concentrated inside the frame along its edges. Center stays light cream and empty, to support dark ink symbols. Distinct crafted inset panels but subtle and elegant, not heavy metal. Fine painted fibers and slightly uneven ink. Frame only about 5% of slot width. Very tiny corner accents. Gentle depth along the inner rim, no strong shadow. Large clear central area. These must read at 48x48 pixels.
Colour order exactly: top left warm amber/ochre; top middle muted azure/steel blue; top right violet/plum; bottom left moss/forest green; bottom middle teal/jade; bottom right ember orange/russet. The colours are visible in the rim and edge wash but not solid fills. Keep creamy parchment consistent across all six centers.
Constraints: NO icons, NO silhouettes, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO objects in slots, NO glowing neon, NO black/dark center, NO outer action-bar frame. Transparent outside each rounded-square slot, opaque parchment inside. No checkerboard background. Keep all six frames uniform in scale.
usage: Six measured frame regions are cropped at runtime and used as the existing rounded buttons' fill textures. The master is installed unchanged. End Turn retains its circular treatment.
